PRE-LAUNCH PREVIEW · CONTENT & INTEGRATIONS IN REVIEW
Search Engine Optimization

Be found. For the right reasons.

Search visibility is only useful when it brings the right buyers. We connect technical foundations, useful content and commercial intent.

The problem behind the brief.

Buyers cannot choose a business they cannot find. Indexing issues, weak local signals and content that misses the question can all limit qualified discovery.

Our approach

Audit the site and search landscape, fix the foundations, then improve the pages that help buyers choose. Assess answer-engine and AI discovery alongside conventional search without promising placements.

What we deliver.

Technical SEO and SEO audits

On-page optimization and search-intent mapping

Content strategy and link earning

Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization

SEO for SaaS and B2B buying journeys

E-commerce search optimization

AI search visibility: AEO and GEO

Structured data and answer-ready content

Tools, chosen for the job

Search Console · Screaming Frog · GA4

Final stack depends on your systems, requirements and budget.

Measurement

Qualified organic leads · non-brand clicks · indexed priority pages

Baselines and targets are agreed during discovery.

Good questions.

Where do we start?

With a discovery conversation, access review and a prioritized scope. Recommendations follow the evidence, not a preset package.

How is success measured?

We agree a baseline and reporting cadence around qualified organic leads · non-brand clicks · indexed priority pages. Targets are set after discovery; outcomes are never guaranteed.

Can you work with our team?

Yes. The engagement can complement your internal marketing, product and engineering teams, with responsibilities agreed before delivery.
